description: The primary administrative office assisting the Prime Minister in coordinating governance, leading policy development, and communicating state activities. It manages national portfolios such as digital transformation, information, and high-priority development strategies.

fullName: Ministry of Finance and the Public Service
description: Responsible for planning and executing the government's fiscal policies, compiling the national budget, managing public debt, administering taxation regimes, and driving public sector modernization to foster economic stability and growth.

Charged with protecting Jamaica's national sovereignty, keeping public order, and supervising national law enforcement agencies (such as the Constabulary and Military), correctional systems, and border entry regulations.

Sets national medical policies, administers the public healthcare system, operates community clinics and primary/secondary hospitals, and drives national initiatives for physical, mental, and nutritional health and wellness.

Directs educational policies and public institutions spanning early childhood, primary, secondary, and tertiary training. It also shapes comprehensive youth development, guidance, support, and engagement frameworks across Jamaica.

fullName: Ministry of Science, Energy, Telecommunications and Transport
description: Fosters digital innovation, steers chemical and physical science portfolios, directs energy efficiency goals, oversees national telecommunications licenses, and administers regulatory controls over road, rail, air, and marine transport.

fullName: Ministry of Economic Growth and Job Creation
description: Coordinates national infrastructure, housing policies, spatial land-use planning, environmental protection, climate resilience initiatives, water asset management, and macro investment portfolios intended to generate employment.

fullName: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade
description: Represents Jamaica's interests in global affairs, maintains sovereign diplomatic interactions, services the diaspora worldwide, and conducts foreign trade negotiations to boost economic development.

fullName: Ministry of Culture, Gender, Entertainment and Sport
description: Preserves Jamaica's cultural heritage, expands creative industries, implements gender equality measures, protects vulnerable populations, and promotes community sports and high-performance athletic achievement.

fullName: Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Mining
description: Drives food security, coordinates agricultural extensions, supports aquaculture and fisheries, regulates mineral exploration, bauxite extraction, and oversees sustainable land utilization practices.

The central bank of Jamaica. Formulates monetary policy, manages currency circulation, acts as the lender of last resort, maintains foreign exchange reserves, and oversees commercial banks to guarantee financial sector stability.

The principal tax collection and auditing authority. Operates tax offices, promotes voluntary compliance, administers corporate and individual tax assessments, collected duties, and modernizes electronic payment systems.

The national statistical agency. Collects, processes, and publishes demographic, sociological, and economic data, such as national population censuses, employment surveys, inflation rates, and GDP calculations.

A statutory planning body that designs development blueprints, tracks macroeconomic trends, monitors the progress of social outcomes, and coordinates development assistance from international agencies.

A state-owned development finance institution providing medium/long-term funding, equity support, technical coaching, and guarantees to MSMEs, infrastructure projects, and public-private partnerships.

The national agency responsible for marketing Jamaica as a prime destination for direct foreign investment. Focuses on export development, business matching, and lowering the barriers to starting enterprises.

A regulatory oversight agency monitoring non-deposit-taking financial institutions. Supervises insurance providers, private pension administrators, securities broker-dealers, and mutual fund structures.
A statutory consumer advocacy body. Enforces consumer protection laws, checks market prices, investigates consumer complaints of unfair billing, and executes diagnostic tests on consumer goods.
The administrative tribunal responsible for enforcing the Fair Competition Act. It acts against monopolistic cartels, misleading advertising, price collusion, and actions restricting market entry.

An agency of the Ministry of Industry, Investment and Commerce. Enforces food safety standards, compulsory trade regulations, packaging guidelines, and regulatory metrology to safeguard consumer health.
The primary civil law enforcement agency. Tasked with crime prevention, intelligence operations, maintenance of public order, dynamic road traffic management, and assisting criminal prosecutions.

The sovereign military organization, comprising land, air, and maritime units. Coordinates coastal defense, anti-smuggling patrols, disaster relief response, and collaborates on high-intensity local police operations.

fullName: Major Organised Crime and Anti-Corruption Agency
description: A specialized elite law enforcement authority targeting drug cartels, cyber crimes, money laundering, state extortion networks, and instances of high-level corruption inside public administration.

A fully civilian-led commission set up to investigate instances of physical harm, shootings, death, or structural misconduct involving members of the security forces, prison wardens, and correctional officers.
The executive agency administering passport services, processing applications for dual citizenship, regulating visa entries, maintaining border gates, and processing tourist/alien residency papers.

Regulates and manages the legal possession of guns by civilian residents. Conducts thorough background checks, executes ballistic certifications, and maintains a strict database of civilian arms and ammo.
The administrative engine implementing general elections, municipal polls, and voter registrations. Keeps the voter ID database, issues national voter cards, and prints ballots.
The independent multi-partisan commission crafting the rules for electoral registration, dividing constituency lines, managing campaign finance transparency, and overseeing the EOJ.

fullName: Office of Disaster Preparedness and Emergency Management
description: The national agency coordinating comprehensive disaster management, emergency shelters, public warnings for floods and hurricanes, and risk mitigation strategies across Jamaica.
Plans and builds main arterial corridors, federal highways, drainage culverts, bridges, and controls urban smart traffic lights to maximize vehicular flow and maintain resilient structural links.
The prime utility provider for water sanitization and distribution. It oversees water reservoirs, treatment filtration facilities, and sewer mains, feeding clean municipal tap water islandwide.
The prime environmental sentinel and spatial mapping regulator. Decides on development permits, conducts environmental impact audits, protects marine sanctuaries, and enforces pollution limits.
Maintains civic public hygiene by collecting, recycling, and disposing of solid waste. Standardizes trash transport services, runs municipal garbage routes, and operates national parks and landfills.
Statutory regulator protecting consumers in the energy, water, telecommunications, and transit sectors. Approves rate reviews, handles infrastructure complaints, and sets benchmark efficiency rates.

A master developer steering sustainable physical reclamation and city-planning. Spearheads commercial urban hubs, manages tourist beaches, parks, and oversees property inventory inside targeted growth areas.
The major public bus service operator, executing scheduled urban transit routes linking Kingston, St. Andrew, Portmore, Spanish Town, and parts of rural St. Thomas.
The federal frequency guardian. Manages public airwaves, issues radio-frequency licenses, prevents transmissions interference, and sets terms for wireless telecom connections.
Owns and develops deepwater maritime harbors, container terminals, and foreign free-zones. It monitors shipping lane dredge depths, port defenses, and tourist cruise-ship piers.
An executive agency sub-portfolio under economic growth ministries. Tasks itself with fabricating affordable housing solutions, regularizing informal communities, and issuing legal land titles.
The primary registry for titles, maps, land valuation indexes, and crown lands. It modernizes land tenure security and integrates spatial land mapping into a single portal.
A centralized public safety body chaired by the Prime Minister. Coordinates road fatality reduction campaigns, analyzes traffic collision telemetry, and revises highway safety policies.

The National Reconstruction and Resilience Authority is a time-bound statutory agency in Jamaica established to accelerate post-hurricane rebuilding and infrastructure resilience. Created to bypass slow bureaucratic processes, its goal is to manage recovery funding efficiently and 'build back better' following the devastation of Hurricane Melissa.
A landmark social-trust fund funded through joint salary levies. Finances affordable housing developments, awards low-interest home loans, and provides housing support to low-income contributors.

fullName: Human Employment and Resource Training / National Service Training Agency
description: The chief vocational development, technical trade, and workforce apprenticeship certifier. Empowers youth with recognized professional credentials across computing, cuisine, mechanics, and carpentry.

fullName: Programme of Advancement Through Health and Education
description: An intensive social safety transfer net. Connects conditional cash grants, free health screenings, and school lunch subsidies to low-resource families to eliminate intergenerational poverty.
An integrated social security safety net. Collects national insurance contributions to offer retirement pensions, industrial injury benefits, invalidity payouts, and widows' support services.
The sole official repository for vital civil statuses. Registers and issues legal certificates for births, marriages, adoptions, deaths, deeds, and manages the national deeds registers.
Regulates and monitors infant schools and daycares. Outlines development standards, safety guidelines, and early-learning curricula to secure solid childhood development blocks.

Coordinates and prompts innovative science and technology research. Develops indigenous waste-treatment bio-digesters, assays local plants for medicine, and counsels food entrepreneurs on stabilization.

fullName: Culture, Health, Arts, Sports and Education
description: A dedicated foundation allocating funding generated via sports betting and lotteries to grant-aid early education schools, support healthcare equipment, and bankroll youth sporting programs.
Supervises and executes drug testing protocols for Jamaican athletes in accordance with the World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA) codes, promoting clean sport and professional athletic fairplay.
Protects and registers intellectual property rights. Administers laws surrounding copyright works, design patents, industrial designs, manufacturing marks, and traditional geographical indications.

fullName: Restoration of Owner or Occupant Family Shelters
description: The ROOFS programme provides financial assistance to rebuild homes that were damaged by hurricane Melissa and assessed through the Ministry of Labour and Social Security.
